principles: Composition theory is the architectural substrate
No claim of success/failure or unmeasured performance
Sleep/wake is not treated as a complete solution to combinatorial growth
World-model use is conditional on paired empirical benefit
Every specified capability remains visible even if implementation is outstanding

supporting_artifacts.role: executable local prototype: sleeping memory, waves and resumable search
paired-utility gate for optional transition model
tests for living memory and search prototype
tests for conditional model activation gate
smoke demonstration output (not an end-to-end evaluation)
validation report with scope and qualifications
LaTeX log for the theory PDF
LaTeX log for the architecture PDF

claims.claim: No LLM/eLLM runtime dependency is part of the specified FulleGenBrain_3 architecture.
claims.evidence: formalism abstract, no-neural-language-model section and feature matrix

claims.claim: The full composition theory is integrated at specification level by including all 29 constructors in the architecture grammar, their semantic contracts, and a constructor-to-runtime coverage matrix.
claims.scope: specification only; does not claim that all operators are implemented
claims.evidence: grammar, theory semantics table, section 'Intégration complète...'

claims.claim: The living-memory prototype supports cold compressed payloads, hash checks, sleep/wake, dependency freshness checks, invalidation, event waves and resumable best-first search to the extent documented by its API/tests.
claims.scope: small reference implementation, not distributed durable production service

claims.claim: Sleep/wake controls working-set residence and memory pressure, but does not solve combinatorial candidate growth alone.
claims.evidence: sections on search scheduling and memory lifecycle

claims.claim: World-model/transition-model use is optional and gated by paired held-out utility/cost/safety results for each task family.
claims.evidence: model-world decision gate in formalism and reference_impl/world_model_gate.py

claims.claim: Historical O62 showed lower reported mean reward for RS than baseline in the cited run (0.1972 vs 0.6833), with PASS/FAIL/EXHAUSTED counts 2/4/12 vs 3/4/11.
claims.scope: historical report only; not a new experimental result and not proof that all world models are useless
claims.evidence: sources/evidence/order62_order63_evidence_extract.json, FulleGenBrain_1 source bundle hash in source_manifest

claims.claim: Historical O63 reported low latent holdout MSE but did not establish generalized decision benefit of the model/RS branch across difficult task families.
claims.scope: historical report only; full campaign not rerun

claims.claim: All 31 current local tests pass; this is not evidence of end-to-end FulleGenBrain_3 capability.
FulleGenBrain_3 is fully implemented as an integrated runtime, including all grammar operators and end-to-end cognition.
claims.scope: not asserted; see matrix for operator-level implementation coverage
claims.evidence: formalism's coverage matrix explicitly marks missing and partial pieces

claims.claim: The entire transition-model hypothesis has been empirically resolved for all task families.
claims.scope: activation remains family- and metric-specific; full O62/O63 campaigns not rerun
claims.evidence: source review and pre-registered gate specification

claims.claim: The current formalism's world-model role is conditional: simulate/predict only when the task class and paired evaluation show material decision value after cost/safety checks.

world_model_evidence.O62: Historical report: baseline PASS/FAIL/EXHAUSTED 3/4/11, RS 2/4/12; mean rewards 0.6833 vs 0.1972; RS not promoted in that snapshot.
world_model_evidence.O63: Historical report: 320 records, 1436 transitions (1162 train / 274 holdout), 27 opaque actions, latent holdout MSE 1.7310954885e-4; no generalized decision gain established.
world_model_evidence.decision: Keep transition/world models optional and activate per task family only after pre-registered paired utility, cost, OOD and safety gates.

source_provenance: sources/evidence/source_manifest.json; source archive hashes are recorded, selected extracts are embedded, larger historical bundles are referenced but not packed inside this release.
